name: Custom Connector Gateway API
title: Custom Connector Gateway API
summary: The Custom Connector Gateway (XCC) API provides an asynchronous ingest endpoint.
overview:
The Custom Connector Gateway (XCC) API provides an asynchronous ingest endpoint for document and principal operations into ServiceNow AI Search.

Max request body size: 100 MB.

About the Gateway Model

ServiceNow's built-in External Content Connectors use a pull model: ServiceNow reaches out to the data source. This breaks when your data is behind a firewall that ServiceNow can't reach, or when no prebuilt connector exists for your source.

The Custom Connector Gateway flips the model. You run a connector in your own environment and push data to ServiceNow. ServiceNow handles the indexing. This API is your ingest surface.

For more information, see Custom Connector Gateway external content connector.

Authentication - Two Layers Required

Every call to this gateway requires an XCC JWT, which is distinct from the OAuth access token used with the Glide instance. Obtain it in two steps:

Step 1 - OAuth access token (from the Glide instance):

POST https://<instance>.service-now.com/oauth_token.do
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
grant_type=client_credentials&client_id=...&client_secret=...

Cache the returned access_token and refresh proactively before expires_in elapses.

Step 2 - XCC JWT (from the Glide instance, using the OAuth token):

GET  https://<instance>.service-now.com/api/sn_ext_conn/xcc_api/jwt/<schema_table>/fetch
POST https://<instance>.service-now.com/api/sn_ext_conn/xcc_api/jwt/<schema_table>/generate
Authorization: Bearer <oauth_access_token>

Use /fetch to retrieve a cached JWT; fall back to /generate to mint a fresh one. The <schema_table> scopes the token to a specific index schema. The XCC JWT expires - re-acquire on a cadence (every 55 minutes is typical).

Pass the XCC JWT as the x-xcc-access-token header on every call to this gateway. Note that the gateway is a separate service from the Glide instance and may run on a different hostname.

End-to-End Crawl Flow

For each crawl run, follow this sequence:

  1. Auth - mint an OAuth access token, then mint an XCC JWT.
  2. Principal sync (optional) - connect to LDAP, resolve user and group identities, and sync via ADDPRINCIPAL so ServiceNow knows your users.
  3. Record crawl_start_millis - capture the epoch-millisecond timestamp before sending any documents.
  4. Discover and ingest - walk your source, encode each file as base64, build an ADDDOCUMENT payload with ACLs, and POST to this endpoint.
  5. Stale content cleanup - after all documents are sent, issue a DELETEBYQUERY to remove anything with indexeddate < crawl_start_millis. AI Search auto-populates indexeddate on every ingested document; you don't set it.

When a file is deleted from your source between crawls, it will not be re-ingested, and the cleanup query removes it from the index automatically.

Requires

  • plugin: sn_ext_conn (External Content Connectors)
  • role: ais__admin
  • crawler role: snc_internal for the integration-user that the client-crawler will use.

Namespace

Base URI: /xcc-ingest (on the XCC Gateway host, not the Glide instance)

members.name: POST /xcc-ingest (ADDDOCUMENT)
members.summary: Adds or overwrites a document in the AI Search index.
members.html:
URL format

Note:
Available versions are specified in the REST API Explorer. For scripted REST APIs there is additional version information on the Scripted REST Service form.

Versioned URL: /xcc-ingest

Supported request parameters

Path parameters
Name Description
api_version Optional. Version of the endpoint to access. For example, v1 or v2. Only specify this value to use an endpoint version other than the latest.

Data type: String
Query parameters
Name Description
None This endpoint does not accept query parameters.
Request body parameters
Name Description
operation Operation type. Value for this topic: ADDDOCUMENT.

Data type: String

Required.
connector Connector identifier. Scopes this document to a specific connector configuration in ServiceNow. Must match the connector registered in the XCC schema.

Data type: String

Required.

Example: my_connector
id Stable, unique identifier for this document within the connector's scope. If a document with this ID already exists, it is replaced. Use a SHA-256 hash of the absolute file path to generate a deterministic ID: the same file always maps to the same ID across crawl runs.

Data type: String

Required.

Example: a3f2c1d0e5b4908172634f5e6a7b8c9d
url Source URL of the document in your system. ServiceNow displays this as the click-through link in search results. Use a URL that resolves to the document in your source system, even if it is behind a firewall.

Data type: String

Required.

Example: https://internal.company.com/docs/report.pdf
file_content Base64-encoded binary content of the document. AI Search extracts text from the decoded bytes for full-text indexing. Base64 encoding increases payload size by approximately 33% - a 75 MB file becomes a ~100 MB payload, which is the gateway's maximum request size.

Data type: String

Required.

Example: SGVsbG8gV29ybGQ=
fields Document metadata as key-to-string-array pairs. All values must be arrays of strings even for single-valued fields. Common metadata keys used by the reference file-system connector.

Data type: Object

Required.

Example: {"file_name": ["report.pdf"], "file_path": ["/data/reports/report.pdf"], "file_size": ["245832"], "file_type": ["pdf"]}
acls Access control list for an ADDDOCUMENT request. Controls which ServiceNow users can see this document in search results.
Exactly one of the following must be true:
  • everyone: true - all authenticated ServiceNow users can see the document
  • none: true - no one can see the document (useful for staging)
  • At least one entry in user_allow or group_allow with everyone: false

Map your source system's permissions to ACL fields. For POSIX filesystems.

Use the same user and group identifiers you registered via ADDPRINCIPAL - the glide_user value for users, and the group names from the groups array.

Data type: Object

Required.
acls.everyone When true, all authenticated ServiceNow users can see this document. Set to false when using user_allow or group_allow.

Data type: Boolean

Optional.
acls.none When true, no user can see this document. Useful for temporarily suppressing content without deleting it.

Data type: Boolean

Optional.

Example: false
acls.user_allow ServiceNow user identifiers (typically email addresses) who are allowed to see this document. Must correspond to glide_user values registered via ADDPRINCIPAL.

Data type: Array

Optional.

Example: ["john.doe@company.com"]
acls.group_allow ServiceNow group names whose members are allowed to see this document. Must correspond to group names registered via ADDPRINCIPAL.

Data type: Array

Optional.

Example: ["Engineering"]

Headers

The following request and response headers apply to this HTTP action only, or apply to this action in a distinct way. For a list of general headers used in the REST API, see Supported REST API headers.

Request headers
Header Description
x-xcc-access-token XCC JWT obtained from the XCC API on the Glide instance. This is the schema-scoped token from /api/sn_ext_conn/xcc_api/jwt/<schema_table>/fetch or .../generate, <b>not</b> the OAuth access token used to mint it. The gateway validates this JWT against the schema before processing the payload.

Data type: String

Example: eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiJ9....
Response headers
Header Description
NoneThis endpoint returns no custom response headers.

Status codes

The following status codes apply to this HTTP action. For a list of possible status codes used in the REST API, see REST API HTTP response codes.

Status codes
Status code Description
202Request accepted for asynchronous processing. The payload has been received by the gateway and will be forwarded to the AI Search index. There is no synchronous confirmation of indexing success - monitor the connector's status in ServiceNow if confirmation is needed.
400 Bad Request. A bad request type or malformed request was detected.
403 Forbidden. The user doesn't have access rights to the specified record.
500 Internal server error. An unexpected error occurred while processing the request. The response contains additional information about the error.
503Concurrency limit reached. The gateway is at capacity. Back off and retry with exponential delay.

Response body parameters (JSON or XML)

Parameter Description

cURL request

Example POST request to /xcc-ingest.

curl "https://instance.servicenow.com/xcc-ingest" \
--request POST \
--header "Accept:application/json" \
--header "x-xcc-access-token: <token>" \
--header "Content-Type:application/json" \
--data '{
  "operation": "ADDDOCUMENT",
  "connector": "my_connector",
  "id": "a3f2c1d0e5b4908172634f5e6a7b8c9d",
  "url": "https://internal.company.com/docs/report.pdf",
  "file_content": "SGVsbG8gV29ybGQ=",
  "fields": {
    "file_name": [
      "report.pdf"
    ],
    "file_path": [
      "/data/reports/report.pdf"
    ],
    "file_size": [
      "245832"
    ],
    "file_type": [
      "pdf"
    ]
  },
  "acls": {},
  "acls.everyone": false,
  "acls.none": false,
  "acls.user_allow": [
    "john.doe@company.com"
  ],
  "acls.group_allow": [
    "Engineering"
  ]
}'
{
  "result": {
    "status": "SUCCESS",
    "message": "Successfully delivered ingest request."
  }
}

members.name: POST /xcc-ingest (DELETEBYQUERY)
members.summary: Deletes all documents for this connector that match an AI Search query.
members.html:
URL format

Note:
Available versions are specified in the REST API Explorer. For scripted REST APIs there is additional version information on the Scripted REST Service form.

Versioned URL: /xcc-ingest

Supported request parameters

Path parameters
Name Description
api_version Optional. Version of the endpoint to access. For example, v1 or v2. Only specify this value to use an endpoint version other than the latest.

Data type: String
Query parameters
Name Description
None This endpoint does not accept query parameters.
Request body parameters
Name Description
operation Operation type. Value for this topic: DELETEBYQUERY.

Data type: String

Required.
connector Connector identifier. Limits the query to documents owned by this connector.

Data type: String

Required.

Example: my_connector
query AI Search query language string. Supported forms.

RANGE query - Delete documents indexed before a timestamp (stale cleanup)

indexeddate:RANGE(*, 1742208000000, lower=exclusive, upper=exclusive)

RANGE query - Delete documents indexed after a timestamp (roll back a bad crawl)

indexeddate:RANGE(1742208000000, *, lower=exclusive, upper=exclusive)

OR query - Delete a specific list of documents by ID.

OR(.id:abc123, .id:def456, .id:ghi789)

Field match - Delete all documents where a field equals a value.

file_type:pdf

The indexeddate field value is epoch milliseconds. Record crawl_start_millis before the first ADDDOCUMENT of the crawl, then use it in the RANGE query at the end of the crawl to remove stale documents.

Required.
